newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kansas City Southern rating lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kansas City Southern rating lowered.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Monday lowered its rating on Kansas City Southern Industries Inc to Outperform (Long Term) from Outperform.

-- Analyst Steve Lewins cited the rail company's higher offer for Mexico's busiest rail line than an offer from a group led by Union Pacific. Carrying costs on the purchase of Ferrocarril "del Noreste" could top $1 per share, said Lewins.
-- Gruntal did not change its $60 price target for Kansas City Southern, which provides rail and truck services.
-- The company's shares ended down one at 47 on the NYSE.
